status: PREPARED/UNEXECUTED; no full story or formal case acceptance
originalAcceptance: Negative tests cover each boundary and prove that hidden screens or manipulated requests cannot expand access.

axes.authority: Trusted identity plus selected active organisation, current membership and org_id-scoped store queries. A requested organisation is a selection, never identity.
axes.allow: Only the actor’s active membership in the selected organisation; existing scoped rows are additionally filtered.
axes.deny: Foreign/no/inactive membership; changing query/header/record IDs cannot expand membership.
axes.allocation: Tenant collisions/canary and contradictory media org belong to root tenant agent, excluded from this new harness.
axes.limit: Hosted backup/index/asynchronous isolation is not established by this preparation.

axes.authority: Server membership role/status, not hidden UI state; per-action authorization is separate from record visibility.
axes.allow: Active clinician/supervisor sees normal in-team scope; ASHA additionally needs direct assignment; clinical mutations use the original care-role controls. Owner retains explicit administrative actions only.
axes.deny: Admin/provider has no normal patient scope. Owner does not bypass patient scope. An allowed read does not imply permission to mutate/export/tool-call.
axes.allocation: Existing broad role/ASHA/anonymous sweep remains authoritative; no duplicate sweep.
axes.limit: No global role-to-all-actions pass inferred from representative actions.

axes.authority: Member teamIds, patient teamId, and ASHA assignedTo; current assignment updates require supported server command, versions and audit.
axes.allow: Team match and, for ASHA, exact assignedTo. Non-ASHA ordinary care scope is in-team scope further constrained by policy.
axes.deny: Wrong team or another worker’s assigned record; previously permitted IDs must be re-evaluated after actual assignment/membership change.
axes.allocation: Existing assignment/revocation sweeps and current routine tests are not duplicated.
axes.limit: Locality-based caseload transfer qualification remains original remaining work.

axes.authority: The first active purposeGrants member rule narrows normal record scope to an existing PROGRAMME_NAMES value present in person.programmes.
axes.allow: No narrowing rule, or person enrolled in the active rule’s named existing programme, subject to all other boundaries.
axes.deny: Active programme rule not present in person.programmes; SQL prefilter and hydrated normal scope must agree.
axes.allocation: Inventory/combined-axis native hydration gap recorded; locality harness does not duplicate programme-only native smoke.
axes.limit: Revoking a narrowing grant restores base permission; it is not membership revocation. No grant expiry semantics exist in this type and none is invented.

axes.authority: Existing owner-managed accessScope config, versioned commands and audit; enabled facility scope is an additional AND boundary. Member facility set is union of team and member references.
axes.allow: Enforcement disabled, or patient facility is in the configured member/team facility set, subject to base scope and other enabled dimensions.
axes.deny: Enabled rule with no member facilities, missing patient facility, or mismatched facility. A member-level reference adds to the team set; it does not replace it.
axes.allocation: Existing native facility-only checks reused by source inventory; no duplicate initial enforcement suite.
axes.limit: These are configured organisation-local references; upstream directory validation and institutional acceptance remain missing.

axes.authority: Existing accessScope.enforceLocality; patient explicit locality takes precedence, otherwise locality is derived from patient facility. Member locality set is union of direct/team and facility-derived localities.
axes.allow: Enforcement disabled, or effective patient locality belongs to the configured member locality set, subject to every other applicable boundary.
axes.deny: Enabled rule with no member locality, patient with neither explicit nor facility-derived locality, or nonmatching effective locality. Explicit out-of-scope locality must not fall back to an in-scope facility.
axes.allocation: Verified missing native enforceLocality:true coverage; prepare new HTTP contract only.
axes.limit: No GPS/polygon/address directory or automatic locality-based transfer is present or claimed.

axes.authority: Existing active grant named ACCESS_PURPOSES values checked at actual data-flow checkpoints; purpose-only restriction leaves normal record reads unchanged.
axes.allow: No grant, programme-only grant with no purposes, or a flow’s purpose appears in the active list, subject to care scope/action/consent/source versions.
axes.deny: New mapped flow of an excluded purpose. Commands not carrying a purpose are not automatically refused.
axes.allocation: Purpose inventory only; no provider/tool invocation in this prepared locality harness.
axes.limit: Lookup of a previously started uncertain flow is intentionally not a new send. Generic replay outcomes must not be classified as new purpose-authorized dispatch without examining the actual operation.

axes.authority: Original command/route schemas, patient/visit resolution, action-specific role/current consent/source/version controls; outbound service dispatch re-reads authority.
axes.allow: The exact action’s current server predicates pass. Read, write, search, export and tool are distinct entry points, not a general allow bit.
axes.deny: Manipulating a screen/action/body cannot bypass the schema, care scope, role, purpose or version checks. Refused new commands must not create visits or mutation receipts.
axes.allocation: New geography harness checks actual startVisit refusal/positive controls and data-plane reads, not all commands.
axes.limit: No all-action acceptance inferred from summary assertions. Export exception excludes emergency access; tool governance/consent/source rules remain separate.

axes.authority: Task source names sensitivity, but current code has no single generic resource-sensitivity policy input. Specific consent, restriction, normal-vs-exceptional scope, clinical-source and media/export policies remain their existing authorities.
axes.allow: Only the exact existing resource/action rule; no new generic policy/classification invented.
axes.deny: No presumed universal permission solely because normal record scope passes.
axes.allocation: Explicit unsupported generic axis; inventory only.
axes.limit: A unified sensitivity classification/policy matrix and source-required named review are not implemented or accepted by this preparation.

surfaces.existingDecision: store.scope binds current facility/locality/programme policy and sets person.assigned; record materialization and read-audit are separate fail-closed boundaries.
patientPage uses viewerScope SQL plus record allowed check; search text uses POST body, not query string, and list/search audit precedes response.
Commands resolve current actor, org/member and targeted patient; care-role, command authorization, schema/version/audit/persistence apply.
Owner administrative eligibility does not widen normal patient scope; included cohort/media scope is checked again before response. Emergency access does not authorize export.
Original care role, consent, source/provider/governance/versions and mapped purpose apply; serviceDispatch reloads authority before and after dispatch audit.

proposedMissingNativeCases.name: Existing org-local references and versioned setup
proposedMissingNativeCases.expected: Supported owner addLocality/addFacility/setTeamLocation/assignPatient commands establish synthetic north/south records; unsupported references and stale policy versions are refused without policy change.

proposedMissingNativeCases.name: No locality enforcement preserves existing permitted team
proposedMissingNativeCases.expected: Same current clinician and team sees all existing six seed records; no new normal permission is created by this test.

proposedMissingNativeCases.name: North locality via facility fallback and explicit precedence
proposedMissingNativeCases.expected: With locality enforcement only, exact permitted set is p_meena and p_farida; p_rajesh explicit south is excluded even at north facility; no-location rows are excluded.

proposedMissingNativeCases.name: Direct guessed ID and denied new write do not bypass locality
proposedMissingNativeCases.expected: Out-of-locality detail returns404 with no record content; startVisit returns403 with no new visit or command receipt; in-locality detail/write positive controls succeed.

proposedMissingNativeCases.name: Fresh request after team locality change uses the new set
proposedMissingNativeCases.expected: After supported team reference changes north→south, exact permitted set becomes p_rajesh and p_aarav; formerly permitted IDs are refused, with preserved stored clinical bytes and denied-write receipt/visit cardinality.

proposedMissingNativeCases.name: Enabled locality with no assignment fails closed
proposedMissingNativeCases.expected: Removing the team locality reference under still-enabled enforcement yields an empty permitted set; direct record detail/write remains refused; config metadata remains owner-only.

proposedMissingNativeCases.name: Member and team locality references form the existing union
proposedMissingNativeCases.expected: An existing owner command adds member-level north alongside team-level south, permitting exact union of the four located records, while no-location records stay excluded.

proposedMissingNativeCases.name: Turning enforcement off restores base scope without rewriting records
proposedMissingNativeCases.expected: Original six-record team visibility returns; no fake directory/transfer or duplicate denied command receipt is created.

unsupportedAndRemaining: Persisted simultaneous facility/locality/programme store reads and nonempty dependent-record selectors, recommended by source inventory; locality-only HTTP preparation does not close this gap.
Original named deployment administrator/identity steward/privacy/security reviewer acceptance
Hosted and actual current-source whole action/read/write/search/export/tool qualification

harnessLimits: Eight locality-only native HTTP groups are authored but unexecuted.
Four supported synthetic draft visits make exact scoped visit joins observable.
Submissions/referrals have no nonempty fixture; their filters are not qualified here.
No simultaneous facility/programme enforcement, mid-await race, export, tool, physical reference or hosted acceptance.
Source/build association must be separately retained and reviewed before runtime allocation.
Execution remains held until root reviews bounded containment for inherited startWorker startup rejection; unseen process cleanup is not claimed.
Seeded-name disclosure checks do not prove every arbitrary derived value, and durable read-audit failure injection is not covered by this locality harness.
